oi: <dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>口語感嘆詞（informal），用來大聲叫住人或表示不滿，語氣直接、不禮貌</dd><dt>字族</dt><dd>oily (形容詞)</dd></dl>
oidium:
n. A genus of minute fungi which form a floccose mass of
filaments on decaying fruit, etc. Many forms once referred to this
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自 o- ＋ -idium</dd></dl>
oik: n. [英][口]鄉巴佬, 蠢貨, 粗人
oil:
n. 油, 石油, 油畫顏料
vt. 塗油於, 使融化成油狀, 加油於
vi. 加燃油, 融化

n. a slippery or viscous liquid or liquefiable substance not miscible with water
n. oil paint containing pigment that is used by an artist

語感
中性，日常與能源、烹飪用語
詞根詞綴
古法語 oile ← 拉丁 oleum「橄欖油」。同源字：olive、petroleum
字族
oily (形容詞)
常見搭配
crude／olive／cooking oil；oil prices／rig／spill；oil painting；change the oil；strike oil
近義詞
petroleum：正式，石油
grease：較稠的潤滑脂或油脂
fat：食物中的脂肪
注意事項
oil 作油品時多不可數，但指不同種類的油時可數：oils；oil painting 是「油畫」
oilcloth: n. cloth treated on one side with a drying oil or synthetic resin
oiled:
a. 塗油的, 用油防水的, 浸油的
[機] 塗油的, 擦油

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；『喝醉的』義為口語</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>oil「油」＋過去分詞字尾 -ed</dd><dt>字族</dt><dd>well-oiled (形容詞)</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>a lightly oiled pan；oiled paper</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">字典例句多為『抹了油的』；『喝醉』義較少見</dd></dl>
oiler:
n. 油商, 加油工, 塗油者, 注油壺
[化] 加油器; 加油者
n. a worker who oils engines or machinery
oilfield: n. a region rich in petroleum deposits (especially one with producing oil wells)
oiliness: n. 油質, 滑溜, 圓滑, 浸油

n consisting of or covered with oil
n smug self-serving earnestness
oilman: n. 石油工人, 石油商

n. a person who owns or operates oil wells
n. a worker who produces or sells petroleum
oilseed: n. any of several seeds that yield oil
oilskin: n. 油布, 油布雨衣
n. a macintosh made from cotton fabric treated with oil and pigment to make it waterproof
oily:
a. 油的, 油滑的, 油嘴的
[化] 油的; 含油的; 油性的; 油質的; 多油的; 油膩的; 油滑的
s. coated or covered with oil

語感
整體中性；形容人「油滑、諂媚」時帶貶義
常見搭配
oily hair／skin；oily fish；an oily liquid；an oily smile
近義詞
obsequious：過度奉承、卑躬屈膝(對應「油滑諂媚」一義)
注意事項
形容人或態度時是貶義的「油腔滑調」；形容食物或皮膚則只是描述含油
字族
oiliness (noun)
oink: n. 豬叫聲, 呼嚕聲

n the short low gruff noise of the kind made by hogs
v utter a high-pitched cry, characteristic of pigs
<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>擬聲詞，模仿豬叫聲</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>擬聲字，來自聲音本身，無拉丁或希臘字根可拆</dd></dl>
ointment:
n. 軟膏, 油膏
[化] 軟膏; 藥膏
n. semisolid preparation (usually containing a medicine) applied externally as a remedy or for soothing an irritation

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>中性</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>古法語 oignement ← 拉丁 unguentum ← unguere（塗抹）</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>antiseptic ointment；put ointment on a cut；a fly in the ointment</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>cream：乳霜，質地通常較輕薄</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">a fly in the ointment 是慣用語，指破壞美好事物的小麻煩，不是真的軟膏</dd></dl>
oiticica: n. [植]奧蒂樹(產於巴西東北部的一種薔薇科植物)
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">葡萄牙語，源自圖皮語</dd></dl>
